title: Keystroke Dynamics: Concepts, Techniques, and Applications

proposed_method.name: Random Forest (RF) Classifier
proposed_method.description: A Random Forest classifier was used for four-emotion classification based on piezoelectric keystroke dynamics using time and pressure dimension features.

primary_performance.experimental_condition: Piezoelectric keystroke dynamics using password entry with time and pressure dimension features, with emotions induced using International Affective Digitized Sounds (IADS) to classify four emotions: happiness, fear, sadness, and disgust
primary_performance.evaluation_setting: Four-emotion classification using a Random Forest classifier

evidence.statement: They used time and pressure dimension features.

dataset.statement: Nahin et al. [77] identified the emotions of users by analyzing the textual patterns of the user's keystroke dynamics. They considered seven basic emotional classes, viz. anger, guilt, disgust, joy, fear, shame, and sadness.

primary_performance.statement: Qi, Jia, and Gao [83] proposed an emotion recognition system based on piezoelectric keystroke dynamics... They obtained an accuracy of 78.31% using the RF Classifier.
